# `jouet pr threads`

- **Usage:** `jouet pr threads [FLAGS] [PR] [SUBCOMMAND]`

List, reply to and resolve review threads

Lists unresolved threads by default, outdated ones included and marked. Each thread is addressed by its first comment's ID, the number in the web UI's `#discussion_r` links (`#note_` on GitLab, `#issuecomment-` on Forgejo). Forgejo cannot resolve threads through its API, so resolving there exits 4 before anything is posted. Bodies are condensed: HTML comments and badges are removed, `<details>` collapse to their summary and each comment is cut at 30 lines with a marker; suggestion blocks are always kept whole.

## Arguments
- **`[PR]`** — The PR: a number, URL, OWNER/REPO#N or branch. Defaults to the current branch's PR

## Global Flags
- **`--repo <OWNER/NAME>`** — The repository for a bare number or branch. Defaults to the git remote

## Flags
- **`--all`** — List resolved threads too
- **`--resolved`** — List only resolved threads
- **`--outdated`** — List only outdated threads
- **`--no-outdated`** — Leave out outdated threads
- **`--author <LOGIN>`** — Only threads started by LOGIN. Repeatable
- **`--bots`** — Only threads started by bots: logins ending in `[bot]`, and the config's `bots`
- **`--no-bots`** — Leave out threads started by bots
- **`--since <TIME>`** — Only threads with a comment posted at or after TIME: RFC 3339, a duration ago such as 2h, or @SHA for when that commit was pushed. Goes by when comments were posted, never by the commit they are on
- **`--path <GLOB>`** — Only threads on paths matching GLOB, a directory, or (without a /) a file name. Repeatable
- **`--include-reviews`** — Also list review summaries and PR conversation comments
- **`--context <N>`** — Show N lines of the file around each thread's line
- **`--full`** — Show comment bodies unaltered
- **`--fail-if-unresolved`** — Exit 1 when any listed thread is unresolved
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
